name: zdeck-public-stack
description: Public Z-Deck firmware layer for LilyGO T-Deck/T-Deck Plus on Meshtastic 2.8. Adds the Z-Deck identity/version surface, forced LongFast public default behavior, on-device WiFi scan/select, GPS/compass refresh fixes, map page switching, persistent map page defaults, offline/SD map prep, tile progress and missing-tile status, compact map/cache overlays, real compass/radar/distance-alert position pages, coordinate-aware map GPS readout, stale saved-home map recovery, clearer message delivery labels, hop counters where packet route data exposes them, latest-activity chat ordering, node-name fallback cleanup, SD message journal support, SD settings backup/restore support, SD prepare/reset tools, SD setup detection/progress readouts, SD-card notice controls, SD ringtone folder support, screen correction tools, serial recovery, a boot progress bar, the Modern Field on-device theme/layout, a public on-device health panel, app-only Wi-Fi updates exposed in the active LVGL Settings screen, OTA/backup button release and progress repaint fixes, home LoRa RX overlap fixes, persistent sidebar-left/right placement with a fixed gutter, a home header that shows the configured owner name instead of a hard-coded CyberDeck label, and a bounded top header that keeps battery icon/percent visible.

release.label: Z-Deck 0.2.31-cyberdeck
release.channelDefaults: LongFast public setup; users add private/admin channels after flashing

targetDevice.sdCard: Supported for maps, local message journal, settings backups, ringtone storage, logs, and prepare/reset setup; USB mass storage is disabled in this public build to keep serial stable.

build.status: WSL PlatformIO build completed successfully from the public patch stack. This public-safe zdeck32 build adds real compass/radar/distance-alert position pages and a compact map options overlay while keeping GPS recovery, visible Settings OTA, Wi-Fi scan/select, SD backup/restore, newest-first chats, stable names, send status, hop counters, battery/header fixes, sidebar gutter fixes, and app-only OTA preservation.

publicSetup.ownerDefault: Meshtastic xxxx until the owner name is configured
publicSetup.shortNameDefault: xxxx until the short name is configured
publicSetup.notes: Users can add their own channels, PSKs, owner names, and admin configuration after flashing with the Meshtastic app or CLI. No private channel data is shipped.
